Most ads just try to sell, but premium brands make people want to pay 10x more.

It’s not about flashy visuals or celebrity endorsements, but about the psychology behind how they advertise.

In this video, I break down the 3 timeless principles premium brands use in their campaigns and how you can apply them today on social media to position your brand as premium, charge higher prices, and create a category of one.

I’ll breakdown:

✅ The hidden psychology behind premium ads
✅ Classic campaigns from Chanel, and Nespresso
✅ Modern social ads from Lululemon, and Represent
✅ My proven 4-step process to create premium ads for your own brand

If you run a premium e-commerce or lifestyle brand, this is how you advertise in a way that feels exclusive, aspirational, and unforgettable.
